C. S. S. D. REC. STBY. Station

Date Sept 10
9 / 9 31

Subject (in full) military situation

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.P.I.

Information has been received from a reliable source that
despite the propaganda of the Nanking Government as to the
present political situation which seems favourable to their side,
Marshals Yen Shih San and Feng Yu Hsiang have decided not to
leave China but are contemplating an expedition against Chiang
Ka Shek from the north with the assistance of the Canton
rulers from the south. Their joint manifesto denouncing
Chiang Ka Shek will probably be issued on October 10 the
anniversary of the establishment of the Republic.
This has been made known to Marshal Chang Hsueh Liang who
in addition to reporting the matter to Nanking has sent out
a circular telegram to the various leaders in China appealing to
them for a peaceful solution of the situation instead of
resorting to hostilities. The Nanking Government is calling
the 4th Plenary Conference to be held at Nanking in the hope
of effecting peace but it is doubtful whether their opponents
will send representatives to attend it.
During Chiang Ka Shek's temporary stay in Shanghai in
connection with the funeral of Madame Sung, his troops in
Kiangsi are reported to have suffered serious defeat at the
hands of communists. It appears that a brigade of
men attached to the 55th Division stationed on the border
of Kiangsi and Kwangtung mutinied on August 15 and deserted
with their arms to join the Kwangtung forces. Taking
advantage of the situation communist soldiers disguised as
famine sufferers appeared at Kau-an and made a surprise
attack on the 2nd Division about 20,000 strong under Gen. Chiang
Koon Huen Zang with the result that the whole army
was nearly annihilated. General Chiang narrowly escaped

主题（全称）军事局势

由谭绍良警司制作 由亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson），首席政治情报员转发

据可靠消息来源称，尽管南京政府宣传目前的政治局势似乎对其有利，但阎锡山元帅和冯玉祥元帅已决定不离开中国，而是正考虑在南方广东统治者的协助下，从北方发起讨伐蒋介石的远征。他们谴责蒋介石的联合宣言可能会在10月10日，即中华民国成立纪念日当天发布。
此事已告知张学良元帅，他除向南京报告此事外，还向中国各位领导人发出通电解，呼吁他们和平解决局势，而非诉诸敌对行动。南京政府正在召集将在南京举行的第四届中央全会，希望能实现和平，但其对手是否会派代表出席尚存疑。
据报道，在蒋介石因宋夫人葬礼暂留上海期间，其在江西的部队遭受了共产党人的严重挫败。据悉，驻扎在江西和广东边境的第55师所属的一个旅于8月15日哗变，携带武器投奔广东部队。共产党士兵利用这一局势，伪装成灾民出现在吉安，对蒋光鼐将军指挥的约2万人的第2师发动突袭，导致该军几乎全军覆没。蒋将军险些被俘

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. S., REGISTRY.
No. S. B. D. 23/3.
Date September 10/9 31.

Subject (in full) General Situation in Central China

Made by D.S.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by Henry Robertson. c.p.i.

According to information secured from recent ar-
rivals in Shanghai from Hunan, the Canton Government started
the Anti-Northern expedition at the end of August, 1931. The
Expedition will proceed by two routes; viz. about 40,000
troops under the command of General Tang Seng-chi (唐生智),
ex-Chairman of the Hunan Provincial Government, on the east
via Lokchong (Kwangtung) and now reaching Chenchow (郴州)
Hunan, and about 40,000 troops under the command of General
Pei Chung-hsi (白崇禧), ex-Commander of the 1st Route of
the General Chiang's army, on the west via Chuanchow (Kwangsi)
and now reaching Kiyang (祁陽) (Hunan). It is also re-
ported that the Canton Government has reached an understanding
with the troops attached to the command of General Ho-Chien
(何鍵), Chairman of the Hunan Province, and now stationed
at Yuhsien (攸縣), Hengchow, Yungfeng (衡州) and Pao-
king, (these troops formerly belonged to General Tang Seng-
chi) with the result that the expeditionary forces of the
Canton Government do not expect to meet any hindrances on
their way forward as far as Siangtan (湘潭) along the Siang
River. Moreover the attitude of General Ho Chien (何鍵),
who is supposed to be loyal to General Chiang, is also reported
to be very doubtful and in consequence of this General Chiang
Kai-shek has appointed General Koo Tsoh-doong (顧祝同), Com-
mander of the Emergency Corps to proceed to Hunan ostensibly
to discuss with General Ho measures to be adopted to meet
situation. The policy of General Chiang assume the defensive
for the time being until the attitude of various commanders
of troops in Hunan has been ascertained.

Pan Lien Pih
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）华中总体局势

由潘连璧副督察制作 由亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson），首席政治情报员转发

根据从近期抵达上海的湖南人士处获得的情报，广东政府于1931年8月底发起了反北伐（Anti-Northern expedition）。此次远征将分两路进行；即：由前湖南省政府主席唐生智将军指挥的约4万名部队，东路经乐昌（广东），现已到达湖南郴州；以及由前蒋将军军队第一路指挥官白崇禧将军指挥的约4万名部队，西路经全州（广西），现已到达湖南祁阳。另有报道称，广东政府已与隶属于湖南省主席何键将军指挥、现驻攸县、衡州、永丰和宝庆的部队达成谅解（这些部队原属唐生智将军），因此广东政府的远征军在沿湘江推进至湘潭之前，预计不会遇到任何阻碍。此外，据报被认为忠于蒋将军的何键将军的态度也非常可疑，因此蒋介石将军任命紧急军团指挥官顾祝同将军前往湖南，名义上是与何将军讨论应对局势的措施。在查明湖南各部队指挥官的态度之前，蒋将军的政策暂时采取守势。

潘连璧
副督察

General Situation in Central China

According to information secured from recent arrivals in Shanghai from Hunan, the Canton Government started the Anti-Northern expedition at the end of August, 1931. The Expedition will proceed by two routes; viz. about 40,000 troops under the command of General Tang Seng-chi (唐生智), ex-Chairman of the Hunan Provincial Government, on the east via Lokchong (Kwangtung) and now reaching Chenchow (郴州) Hunan, and about 40,000 troops under the command of General Pei Chung-hai (白崇禧), ex-Commander of the 1st Route of the General Chiang's army, on the west via Chuanchow (Kwangsi) and now reaching Kiyang (祁陽) (Hunan). It is also reported that the Canton Government has reached an understanding with the troops attached to the command of General Ho-Chien (何鍵), Chairman of the Hunan Province, and now stationed at Yuhsien (攸縣), Hengchow, Yungfeng (衡州) and Paoking, (these troops formerly belonged to General Tang Seng-chi) with the result that the expeditionary forces of the Canton Government do not expect to meet any hindrances on their way forward as far as Siangtan (湘潭) along the Siang River. Moreover the attitude of General Ho Chien (何鍵), who is supposed to be loyal to General Chiang, is also reported to be very doubtful and in consequence of this General Chiang Kai-shek has appointed General Koo Tsuh-deong (顧祝同), Commander of the Emergency Corps to proceed to Hunan ostensibly to discuss with General Ho measures to be adopted to meet situation. The policy of General Chiang assumes the defensive for the time being until the attitude of various commanders of troops in Hunan has been ascertained.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Ss. & Z. B. R. C. Station,
No. S. B. D. 23/3.
Date May 1, 1931.
Subject (in full) Political Crisis in Canton.
Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by W. Duncan I.S.P.

Sir,
The following telegrams from Canton dated
April 30 have been received by local Japanese news agencies :-
The political situation in Canton has been
strained since the despatch of General Chen Chi-tang's telegram
to Nanking on April 28th demanding that Mr. Hu Han-ming and
General Li Chi-sen be immediately released. It is reported
that the declaration of Kwangtung and Kwangsi Independence
and the organization of a new government will be proclaimed on
May 5th by Generals Chen Chi-tang, Li Chung-jen and Chang Fa-kuei.
General Chen Ming-chu and a few of the
principal Cantonese officials left Canton for Hongkong on the
night of April 28th.
Enquiries made in this connection show that
on April 26 a conference of military officers above the rank
of divisional commanders was held to discuss matters relating
to the immediate release of Mr. Hu Han-min and General Li Chi-sen
by the Nanking Government. It was decided to send a telegram
under joint signatures of the commanders of the Kwengtung and
Kwangsi armies to Nanking on April 28th demanding their immediate
release. General Chen Min-chu was invited to attend the meeting
and asked to co-operate with them, but he did not give an
immediate reply and left for Hongkong on April 28th accompanied
by the Chief of the Public Safety Bureau and the Provincial
Finance Commissioner.
According to information received from
Reorganizationists, it has been decided that the independence
of Kwangtung and Kwangsi Provinces will be proclaimed in
conjunction with leaders of Kweichow, Yunnan and Szechuen

主题（全称）广东政治危机。
由梅本（Umemoto）日本侦探制作 由W. 邓肯（W. Duncan），印度籍警官转发

先生，
当地日本新闻机构收到了以下发自广州、日期为4月30日的电报：
自4月28日陈济棠将军向南京发出电报，要求立即释放胡汉民先生和李济深将军以来，广东的政治局势一直紧张。据报道，陈济棠、李济深和张发奎将军将于5月5日宣布广东和广西独立，并组织新政府。
陈铭枢将军和几位主要的广东官员于4月28日晚离开广州前往香港。
对此事的调查显示，4月26日召开了一次师长级以上军官会议，讨论有关南京政府立即释放胡汉民先生和李济深将军的事宜。会议决定以粤桂两军指挥官的联名名义，于4月28日向南京发送电报，要求立即释放他们。陈铭枢将军受邀出席会议并被要求与他们合作，但他未立即答复，并于4月28日在公安局局长和省财政厅厅长的陪同下前往香港。
根据从改组派获得的情报，已决定广东和广西省的独立将与贵州、云南和四川的领导人联合宣布

telegram from Nanking:-
Chiang Kai Shek and his wife went to
Tangshan on May 21 and returned to Nanking on the
following day.
So Ts Hsueh, a member of the Central
Supervisory Committee of the Kuomintang, proceeded
to Tangshan at 8 a.m. May 21 to furnish a report to

On the evening of the same day So Ts Hsueh

page_data.en:
May 22, 31

Political (5)

Nanking Government officials join the Canton Rebellion

It is reported that about May 5 Major Chang ei-tseng 張惠長, Chief of the Aviation Bureau, Nanking, accompanied by about 24 pilots and assistants fled from Nanking to Canton taking with them 12 aeroplanes and a number of bombs. Chang ei-tseng is alleged to have planned to take Hu Han-min in one of the aeroplanes but efforts to buy over the guards proved unsuccessful.

Liu Chi-wen (劉化文), ex-Superintendent of Chinese Customs and reputed to be one of the most trusted servants of Chiang Kai-shek is reported to have left Shanghai for Canton to join the Southern cause.

It is also reported that Sun Fo, Minister of Railways and Dr. Eugene Chen, former Minister of Foreign Affairs, travelling under assumed names left Shanghai for Hongkong en route to Canton in the Asama Maru on May 21.
page_data.zh:
1931年5月22日

政治 (5)

南京政府官员加入广东叛乱

据报道，约在5月5日，南京航空局局长张惠长少将，在约24名飞行员和助手的陪同下，携带12架飞机和一批炸弹从南京逃往广州。据称张惠长曾计划用其中一架飞机带走胡汉民，但收买守卫的努力未能成功。

据报道，前中国海关税务司、 reputed to be one of the most trusted servants of Chiang Kai-shek（被认为是蒋介石最信任的仆从之一）的刘化文已离开上海前往广州，加入南方阵营。

另据报道，铁道部长孙科和前外交部长陈友仁使用化名，于5月21日乘坐“浅间丸”号（Asama Maru）离开上海前往香港，途中转往广州。

page_data.en:
May 21, 1931. Morning Situation.

The Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
At 9 a.m. yesterday Sun Fo and Li Shih
Tseng, members of the Central Supervisory Committee of
the Kuomintang, called on Chang Hsing Lang with whom
they discussed the steps to be taken to effect an
amicable settlement of the Canton dispute.
It is reported that they have secured
approval for Hu Han Ming to go abroad. His departure
will greatly assist the bringing about a solution of
the Canton trouble.
Sun Fo, in his telegram to Chiang Kai Shek,
urges that Hu Han Ming be released. Chiang Kai Shek is
reported to be in favour of his release and will not
interfere with the movements of Hu Han Ming.
A certain important person at Canton has
sent a telegram to Sun Fo proposing the formation of
a Military Government and asking his approval of the
scheme. Sun Fo replied that he was not in favour of
such a Government.
The Sin Wen Pao publishes the following
telegram from Nanking:-
Chang Chi, member of the Central Supervisory
Committee of the Kuomintang, has declared that he will
leave Nanking in a day or two for Shanghai where he
will discuss the Canton question with Sun Fo.
Tsai Yuan Pei and Dr. K. H. King left
Nanking for Shanghai on the evening of May 20 to assist
Chang Hsing Lang and Li Shih Tseng in mediating in the
Canton trouble.
The Eastern Times reported that Mr. Eugene
Chen yesterday called on Sun Fo at the latter's residence.
It is reported that Mr. Chen is endeavouring on behalf
of his father-in-law (Chang Hsing Lang) to ask Sun to
mediate in the Canton dispute.

（批：SMF. 21/5）
（批：WF.）

1931年5月21日。晨间情况。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
昨日上午9时，国民党中央监察委员孙科与李石曾拜访张静江，商讨采取何种步骤以和平解决广东争端。
据悉，他们已获准胡汉民出国。胡的离境将极大地有助于促成广东问题的解决。
孙科在致蒋介石的电文中，敦促释放胡汉民。据报道，蒋介石赞成释放胡汉民，且不会干涉胡汉民的行动。
广州某重要人物致电孙科，提议组建军政府，并征求其对该方案的同意。孙科回复称，他不赞成此类政府。

《新闻报》刊登如下来自南京的电文：——
国民党中央监察委员张继宣布，他将在一两天内离开南京前往上海，在那里与孙科讨论广东问题。
蔡元培和金仲华博士于5月20日晚离开南京前往上海，协助张静江和李石曾调解广东纠纷。
《字林西报》报道，陈友仁先生昨日在其寓所拜访了孙科。据报道，陈先生正代表其岳父（张静江）请求孙科调解广东争端。

（批注：SMF. 21/5）

MISCELLANEOUS

PURCHASE OF JAPANESE ARMS BY CANTON DENIED BY JAPAN

The Shanghai Nichi-Nichi publishes
the following report:-
A Tokyo telegram dated August 2,
reports that on July 30 Dr. C. T. Wang, Minister of
Foreign Affairs delivered a memorandum to Mr. Shigemitsu,
Japanese Charge D'affaires, requesting that the Japanese
Government refrain from supplying arms to the Canton
Government. With reference to this matter the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Japanese Government
reports that they have never heard of any negotiations
having taken place for the purchase of arms or engaging
Japanese military officers by the Canton Government
which was erroneously reported to have formed the
matter of conversation between Mr. Shidehara, Minister
of Foreign Affairs of Japan, and Mr. Eugene Chen,
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Canton Government
when they met the other day. The Japanese authorities
further explained that the government will not supply
arms to the Canton Government other than in accordance
with the proper proceedings in such cases as Japan's
policy is not to interfere in Chinese political affairs.
The Nanking Government should not distrust the Japanese
Government in connection with said arms transactions
because Japan knows very well that even though the
Canton Government should purchase arms, Japan could
not transport them to China without the approval of
the Central Government, and for that reason the Japanese
will communicate with the Nanking Government through
Mr. Shigemitsu to assure Nanking that the Japanese
Government will not sell arms to Canton.

CHINESE BANDITS KIDNAPPED TWO JAPANESE FOR RANSOM

The Shanghai Nichi-Nichi publishes
the following report:-
A Changchun telegram dated
August 1, reports that at 10 a.m July 31, Chinese
bandits kidnapped two Japanese who were supervising the
repair work on a bridge at a place one mile from
Changchun. The bandits demand $51,000.00 cash,
5,000 rifles and 1,000(?) rounds of ammunition as
ransom for the release of both Japanese.

（批：Anti-Japanese 3/8）

杂项

日本否认向广东出售武器

《上海日日新闻》刊登如下报道：——
据8月2日东京电报称，7月30日，外交部长王正廷向日本代办重光葵递交备忘录，请求日本政府停止向广东政府供应武器。关于此事，日本政府外交部报告称，他们从未听说广东政府曾就购买武器或聘用日本军官进行过任何谈判；此前有错误报道称，此事是日本外相币原喜重郎与广东政府外交部长陈友仁日前会面时的谈话内容。日本当局进一步解释称，除非按照此类案件的正确程序办理，否则政府不会向广东政府供应武器，因为日本的政策是不干涉中国政治事务。南京政府不应因上述武器交易而怀疑日本政府，因为日本非常清楚，即使广东政府购买武器，若未经中央政府批准，日本也无法将其运往中国；因此，日本人将通过重光葵与南京政府沟通，向南京保证日本政府不会向广东出售武器。

中国匪徒绑架两名日本人以索取赎金

《上海日日新闻》刊登如下报道：——
据8月1日长春电报称，7月31日上午10时，中国匪徒在距离长春一英里处绑架了两名正在监督桥梁维修工作的日本人。匪徒要求支付现金51,000.00美元、步枪5,000支以及子弹1,000(?)发，作为释放这两名日本人的赎金。

（批注：反日 3/8）

SHANGHAI SPECIAL AGENTS ACTIVITIES

The Shanghai Post, a composite paper, published
the following report on July 28:-
Since the hostilities broke out between
the Nanking and Hankow Governments, the former has
been employing every effort to subdue the latter.
A large party of young and experienced secret agents
was recently despatched to Shanghai to conduct activities
in accordance with Canton's instructions. Their first
mission, i.e., the assassination of T. V. Soong, Minister
of Finance, proved unsuccessful. Their schemes include
an attack on and occupation of the offices of Admiralty
and the Shanghai Arsenal at Gung Wan. The two latter
institutions obtained timely warning and consequently
the necessary preparations were made. A large number
of policemen is now stationed in the vicinity of the
offices of Admiralty and the Shanghai Arsenal to watch
the movement of pedestrians. All communications are
closed at night and no person can pass that way
without passports. Hotels and boarding houses are
being carefully searched with the object of locating
and arresting secret agents. It is rather difficult to
locate them as they keep their movements so secret that
no information can be obtained.

MEASURES TO ENSURE RAILWAY TRAFFIC IN SHANGHAI

The following report appears in the Sin Wen
Pao and other local newspapers:-
At 1 p.m., July 29, General Hsu Ching Yuan
together with the Chief Staff Officer, the Chief Adjutant,
and other officials of the Lungwha Headquarters of the
Kwangtung-Shanghai Garrison Commandancy held a conference
with Col. Chen Hsi Tseng, Chief of the Public Safety
Bureau, Chen Jung Su of the Shanghai-Nanking Railway,
Tang Tso Nan, Chief of the Railway Police and Yen Shih
Lun of the Military Police to discuss the adoption of
measures for the preservation of peace on the Shanghai-
Nanking and Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railways. The
conference broke up at 4 p.m.

上海特工活动

综合性报纸《上海邮报》于7月28日刊登如下报道：——
自南京政府与武汉政府爆发敌对行动以来，前者一直竭尽全力制服后者。最近，一大群年轻且经验丰富的秘密特工被派往上海，按照广东方面的指示开展活动。他们的首要任务，即刺杀财政部长宋子文，未能成功。他们的阴谋包括攻击并占领位于高昌庙的海军部和上海兵工厂。后两个机构及时获得了警告，因此做好了必要的准备。目前，大量警察部署在海軍部和上海兵工厂附近，监视行人动向。夜间所有通道关闭，无护照者不得通行。旅馆和寄宿处正受到仔细搜查，目的是 locating 并逮捕秘密特工。由于他们行动极其隐秘，难以获取任何情报，因此很难找到他们。

确保上海铁路交通的措施

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
7月29日下午1时，淞沪警备司令部龙华总部总指挥徐景源将军，会同参谋长、副官长及其他官员，与公安局局长陈希曾上校、京沪铁路局陈荣祖、铁路警察局长唐佐南以及宪兵严世伦举行会议，讨论采取措施以维护京沪铁路和沪杭甬铁路的治安。会议于下午4时结束。

x 参见档案 15.5.2617.

July 30, 1986. Afternoon Translation

HIGHLINE

(批：Please.)

It is reported that the following decisions
were reached during the conference:-
(A) That henceforth the Railway Police will undertake
the responsibility of issuing traffic directions
and preserving peace and order at the railway
stations.
(B) That the work of railway defence and searching passengers
and their luggage will be done by the soldiers of
the accompanying Garrison Detachment in
co-operation with the officers of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Military Police. A joint notice
to this effect will be issued soon.

members of the Aviation Corps of the Nanking Government
ordered by former Chief to go to Canton

It is reported that a confidential telegraphic order
was received on June 17 by officers of the various units of
the Aviation Corps of the National Government from General
Chang Hui-chang (張惠長) of the Canton Government,
instructing them to desert with their aeroplanes and fly
to Canton and serve under the Canton Government. Chang Hui
chang who was formerly Chief of the Aviation Department of
the National Government secretly left Nanking for Canton
with his subordinates at the end of May, taking with them
16 aero planes (Vide I.R. of May 27, 1931).

（批：as above）

南京政府航空队成员奉前队长之命前往广东

据报道，6月17日，国民政府航空队各单位军官收到广东政府张惠长将军的一份密电令，指示他们驾驶飞机叛逃至广东，并在广东政府麾下效力。张惠长原任国民政府航空署署长，于5月底携下属秘密离开南京前往广东，带走了16架飞机（见1931年5月27日情报报告）。

RELATION TO THE CANTON SITUATION

The Sin Wen Pao publishes the following
telegram from Nanking:-
Chang Chi, a member of the Central
Supervisory Committee of the Kuomintang, who is now
in Canton attempting to mediate in the Canton dispute,
has wired to Nanking reporting that the views of the
various leaders and forwarding the following two
demands:-
1) That the Central Supervisory Committee
of the Kuomintang should be allowed to select a
suitable place to hold a conference to discuss the
impeachment made by Tso Ting Pang and three other
members of the Central Supervisory Committee of the
Party against Chiang Kai Shek and that Tso Ting Pang
and the three other members of the Party concerned
should be permitted to attend the conference.
2) That the example of the North-East
(Three Eastern Provinces) should be followed and
a Political Affairs Committee should be established
at Canton to deal with the military and political
affairs in Kwangtung and Kwangsi Provinces.
Chang Chi is now awaiting instructions
from Nanking.

- - - - - - - - - -

Wu Tih Heng, a member of the Central
Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, returned to
Nanking from Shanghai on the morning of June 5
and called on Chiang Kai Shek. In the afternoon
he paid a call on Chang Ching Chiang, Woo Tieh Heng and
Tsai Yuan Pei, members of the Central Supervisory
Committee of the Party, reporting his progress in
Shanghai in the solution of the Canton split.
Wu Tih Heng left Nanking for Shanghai on
the evening of the same day in company with Tsai
Yuan Pei, Tang Mao Kuen (Principal of the Chiao
Tung University at Shanghai) and General Hsiung Shih
Hui, the Soochow-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner.

31.6.6.

与广东局势的关系

《新闻报》刊登如下来自南京的电文：——
目前正在广东试图调解广东争端的国民党中央监察委员张继，致电南京报告各位领袖的观点，并提出以下两项要求：——
1) 允许国民党中央监察委员会选择适当地点召开会议，讨论左斗蓬及中央监察委员会其他三名委员对蒋介石提出的弹劾案，并允许左斗蓬及其他三名相关党员出席会议。
2) 效仿东北（东三省）的先例，在广州设立政治分会，以处理广东和广西两省的军事和政治事务。
张继目前正在等待南京的指示。

- - - - - - - - - -

国民党中央执行委员吴铁城于6月5日上午从上海返回南京，并拜会了蒋介石。下午，他拜访了党的中央监察委员张静江、吴铁恒(音译)和蔡元培，汇报其在上海为解决广东分裂局面所取得的进展。
吴铁城于当晚与蔡元培、唐茂坤（上海交通大学校长）以及苏沪卫戍司令熊式辉将军一同离开南京前往上海。
